description: Figure: published AlphaFold-Multimer screen places FMC1 between mtACP and ATPAF2/Atp12, with no predicted contact to any F1 subunit, while ATPAF2 and ATPAF1 do contact F1 alpha and beta.
code:
import os, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import networkx as nx
D = os.getcwd()
main = pd.read_excel(os.path.join(D,'afm_MOESM4.xlsx'), sheet_name='main_table')
cons = pd.read_excel(os.path.join(D,'afm_MOESM5.xlsx'), sheet_name='Consolidated')

def first(g): return str(g).split(',')[0].strip()
main['g1']=main['Gene 1'].map(first); main['g2']=main['Gene 2'].map(first)
core = ['FMC1','ATPAF2','ATPAF1','ATP5F1A','ATP5F1B','NDUFAB1']
sub = main[main.g1.isin(core) & main.g2.isin(core)]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14,5.6))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1,3, width_ratios=[1.25,1,1], wspace=0.35)

# A: network
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
G = nx.Graph()
for _,r in sub.iterrows(): G.add_edge(r.g1, r.g2, w=r['ipTM mean'])
pos = {'NDUFAB1':(0,1.0),'FMC1':(0,0.35),'ATPAF2':(0.95,0.35),'ATPAF1':(0.95,1.0),
       'ATP5F1A':(1.9,0.70),'ATP5F1B':(1.9,0.0)}
for u,v,d in G.edges(data=True):
    x=[pos[u][0],pos[v][0]]; y=[pos[u][1],pos[v][1]]
    ax.plot(x,y,c='#2c3e50',lw=1+6*(d['w']-0.6),zorder=1)
    ax.text(np.mean(x),np.mean(y)+0.045,"%.2f"%d['w'],ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#2c3e50')
# absent edges
for a,b in [('FMC1','ATP5F1A'),('FMC1','ATP5F1B')]:
    ax.plot([pos[a][0],pos[b][0]],[pos[a][1],pos[b][1]],c='#c0392b',ls=':',lw=1.4,zorder=0)
    ax.text((pos[a][0]+pos[b][0])/2,(pos[a][1]+pos[b][1])/2-0.07,'not predicted',
            ha='center',fontsize=7.5,color='#c0392b')
cols = {'FMC1':'#8e44ad','ATPAF2':'#e67e22','ATPAF1':'#e67e22','ATP5F1A':'#27ae60',
        'ATP5F1B':'#27ae60','NDUFAB1':'#2980b9'}
for n,(x,y) in pos.items():
    ax.scatter([x],[y],s=1500,c=cols[n],edgecolor='k',zorder=2)
    ax.text(x,y,n,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,color='w',fontweight='bold',zorder=3)
ax.set_xlim(-0.45,2.4); ax.set_ylim(-0.3,1.35); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('A  AlphaFold-Multimer compendium (PMID 42778582)\nedge label = mean ipTM', loc='left', fontsize=11)

# B: ipTM bars
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
lab = ["FMC1 - ATPAF2","ATPAF2 - ATP5F1A","ATPAF2 - ATP5F1B","FMC1 - NDUFAB1",
       "ATPAF1 - ATP5F1B","FMC1 - ATP5F1A","FMC1 - ATP5F1B"]
val = [0.7816,0.7815,0.7480,0.6696,0.6662,0,0]
c   = ['#8e44ad','#e67e22','#e67e22','#2980b9','#e67e22','#c0392b','#c0392b']
ax.barh(range(len(lab)), val, color=c, edgecolor='k', linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(lab))); ax.set_yticklabels(lab, fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(0.5, ls='--', c='k', lw=1)
for i,v in enumerate(val):
    ax.text(v+0.012 if v else 0.012, i, "%.3f"%v if v else "absent from screen",
            va='center', fontsize=8, color='k' if v else '#c0392b')
ax.set_xlim(0,1.02); ax.set_xlabel('mean ipTM (5 models)')
ax.set_title('B  FMC1 contacts the chaperone, not its client', loc='left', fontsize=11)

# C: cross-species ipTM
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
sp = ['H.sapiens','M.musculus','R.norvegicus','X.laevis','D.rerio','D.melanogaster','C.elegans']
row_a = cons[cons.Pairs=='Q96HJ9_Q8N5M1'].iloc[0]
row_n = cons[cons.Pairs=='Q96HJ9_O14561'].iloc[0]
x = np.arange(len(sp))
ax.plot(x,[row_a[s] for s in sp],'o-',c='#8e44ad',label='FMC1 - ATPAF2')
ax.plot(x,[row_n[s] for s in sp],'s-',c='#2980b9',label='FMC1 - NDUFAB1 (mtACP)')
ax.axhline(0.5, ls='--', c='k', lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(sp, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0.4,0.9); ax.set_ylabel('ipTM'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('C  Both predictions hold in 7 of 7 species tested', loc='left', fontsize=11)
plt.show()
